verdict.rationale: Bruno documents importing existing Postman collections. A release note adds a 'preserve scripts option for Postman import/export', which implies two-way Postman conversion. Collections are also stored as portable plain-text Bru files on the filesystem. Missing for 10: evidence of formats beyond Postman (e.g. OpenAPI, Insomnia, HAR), first-party docs describing the export workflow in depth, and independent hands-on confirmation of round-trip fidelity.

support.subject: As a developer, I can import and export collections in portable formats to move between tools

citations.quote: it also has a feature for importing your existing Postman collections to Bruno
add preserve scripts option for Postman import/export
Bruno stores your collections directly in a folder on your filesystem. We use a plain text markup language, Bru, to save information about API requests.
